title: Pipeline check: six sessions that prove the harness runs end to end (it decides nothing)

hypotheses.text: None about the configurations: this run proves that the service, the browser, the page, the runner, the analysis and the report work together. Six sessions cannot say anything about configuration B.

conditions.rationale: The catalog condition of the startup experiment: 300 ms before the first byte of every response makes every download measurable by the player's estimator, for the whole session.

metrics.thresholdBasis: A tenth of a second is the smallest startup change a viewer notices on a page load. A pipeline check decides nothing, so the number only has to be there.

decisionRule.text: Ship B only if it is better on a primary metric beyond the threshold and not worse on any; do not ship B if it is worse beyond the threshold with an interval that excludes zero; otherwise keep A. A pipeline check applies none of it.

exclusionRule.text: A session that errors or times out is a failed session: it is reported and never silently dropped; its metrics are left out of the comparison.
